sloka: अश्रु पूर्ण मुखीम् दीनाम् कृशाम् अननशेन च ।शोक ध्यान पराम् दीनाम् नित्यम् दुह्ख परायणाम् ॥५-१५-२३॥
transliteration: aśru pūrṇa mukhīm dīnām kṛśām ananaśena ca ।śoka dhyāna parām dīnām nityam duhkha parāyaṇām ॥5-15-23॥

translations.english: Her face was filled with tears. She looked dejected and emaciated due to fasting. Always plunged in grief, she looked like one meditating in tears.
